recipe.name: Light
evidence: npm run dev starts the Fastify control plane (src/server-main.ts), not a Vite dev server, so the auto-detected Vite port 5173 never answers.
Server defaults to PORT 8787; verification pins 8799 so a running dev server or an unrelated process on 8787 cannot collide with it.
LIGHT_DB=:memory: keeps the verification run from touching data/light.db.
/healthz is the only unauthenticated endpoint; / is not routed and every /v1 and /admin path returns 401 by design.
